title: MemoryWriteRequest.v1
description: A request to write/remember content into a memory/context provider behind a Baltor wrapper. The wrapper turns the result into a candidate MemoryArtifact — it NEVER creates a served/canonical fact directly. Every write is bound to a (tenant_id, container) so memory cannot leak across tenants, and carries the injected time so the operation is deterministic.

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant. Required: no anonymous/global writes.

container.description: Project/container scope within the tenant the memory is written under.

content.description: The payload to remember. Stored losslessly; never overwritten by later transforms.

metadata.description: Optional caller metadata (tags, source hints). Provider-opaque.

external_source_handle.description: Optional upstream handle if re-ingesting a known provider memory id.

provider_hint.description: Optional preferred provider_id. The wrapper still routes through the registered provider; never bypasses the port.

now.description: Injected time for the write (deterministic; no wall-clock).
